statement: One role-indexed A/B/C relation remains one n-ary relation.
package_behavior: No AB, AC, or BC relation is generated.

statement: A reported A-to-B bridge is directional.
Separate A-to-B and B-to-C reports remain separate.
A cell digest is addressed together with its chart.
package_behavior: Digest reuse across charts does not merge cells or establish equality.

statement: Different perspectives may report incompatible postures.
package_behavior: The package preserves them side by side and selects no winner.

statement: A correction may explicitly supersede one same-subject same-perspective claim.
package_behavior: The earlier claim stays present and no latest truth is selected.

statement: Empty atlases, empty charts, isolated cells, and disconnected charts are valid.
package_behavior: Isolation, rest, refusal, and nonparticipation receive no penalty.

statement: The protocol has no score, rank, weight, centrality, quality, or sameAs field.
package_behavior: Validation rejects extra properties and performs no semantic classification.

statement: Digest-only refs remove raw prose from this wire shape.
package_behavior: A digest can remain identifying or linkable and is not anonymization.

statement: An atlas is inert content-addressed geometry.
package_behavior: It performs no network, model, credential, publication, task, wallet, or economic effect.
